scene_description: Granite countertop with a folded gray sweatshirt on the left and a black-cased iPad on the right. A white charger sits separately between the clothing and iPad.

targets.name: black iPad
targets.description: Black-cased iPad lying screen-down on the right side of the countertop, to the right of the separate white charger.
targets.clearance_notes: Back and surrounding edges are exposed, with space separating it from the charger and clothing.
targets.other_notes: Dimensions treated as the photographed iPad with its case. Flat orientation alone is not treated as needing correction.

targets.name: white charger
targets.description: Small white plug-in charger resting directly on the counter between the gray clothing and black iPad, with metal prongs facing upward.
targets.orientation: resting with plug prongs facing upward
targets.clearance_notes: Top and sides are exposed; no other object covers or presses against the charger. Moving it closer to the front edge would improve access from the front of the counter.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the white charger approximately 10 cm toward the front edge of the counter, keeping it fully supported.

targets.name: gray sweatshirt
targets.description: Folded gray sweatshirt on the left side of the granite countertop, to the left of the black iPad, with a sleeve extending toward the front edge.
targets.clearance_notes: Top and side edges are exposed, with no objects resting on the sweatshirt. The front sleeve is near the counter edge and accessible.
targets.other_notes: Dimensions describe the folded sweatshirt. Fabric can change shape when lifted.

source: Staged permutation of S0028, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
